evals.prompt:
Two legacy screens, same product, both scroll badly. Android (Views, RecyclerView) and iOS (UIKit). Give me concrete fixes for both, save as review.md.

Android adapter:
```kotlin
class OrderAdapter(var orders: List<Order>, val customers: List<Customer>) : RecyclerView.Adapter<OrderVH>() {
    fun update(newOrders: List<Order>) { orders = newOrders; notifyDataSetChanged() }  // called every 2s by polling
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(p: ViewGroup, t: Int) = OrderVH(LayoutInflater.from(p.context).inflate(R.layout.row_order, p, false))
    override fun onBindViewHolder(h: OrderVH, pos: Int) {
        val o = orders[pos]
        val c = customers.first { it.id == o.customerId }
        h.name.text = c.name
        h.date.text = SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM, HH:mm", Locale.US).format(o.createdAt)
        h.total.text = NumberFormat.getCurrencyInstance().format(o.total)
        h.avatar.setImageBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeFile(c.avatarPath))
    }
    override fun getItemCount() = orders.size
}
```
row_order.xml is LinearLayout(vertical) > LinearLayout(horizontal, weights) > RelativeLayout > ... 6 levels deep. Each row also holds a horizontal RecyclerView of product thumbnails with its own new adapter created in onBind.

iOS:
```swift
func collectionView(_ cv: UICollectionView, cellForItemAt ip: IndexPath) -> UICollectionViewCell {
    let cell = cv.dequeueReusableCell(withReuseIdentifier: "order", for: ip) as! OrderCell
    let o = orders[ip.item]
    let fmt = DateFormatter(); fmt.dateFormat = "dd MMM, HH:mm"
    cell.date.text = fmt.string(from: o.createdAt)
    cell.avatar.image = UIImage(contentsOfFile: o.avatarPath)
    cell.layer.cornerRadius = 12; cell.layer.masksToBounds = true
    cell.layer.shadowRadius = 6; cell.layer.shadowOpacity = 0.3
    return cell
}
// polling every 2s: self.orders = new; self.collectionView.reloadData()
```
About 1,500 orders.
